notes.title: Hotfix: cumulative moves/points achievements
notes.notes:
Back in March there were bug reports that the cumulative movement/points achievements didn't work properly. I did notice these bug reports and promised a fix but yeah ... this shouldn't have taken as long as it did. I can only apologize to everyone affected by the bug and hope that this update will let you finally complete the game.

There are two technical groups of achievements - the score per game ones which get resolved internally and work, and the cumulative ones that didn't work. This had to do with the overly convoluted way I was processing these stats - and the fact I didn't bother to fetch them from Steam so you more or less started at a random value. This was bad, and it's fixed now:

- your stats are fetched from Steam on every launch of the game
- stats are committed immediately after they change, but only pushed to the server every 30 seconds the game is running (doesn't need to be in-match, menus work too)

I have throughoutly tested this build and while the stats on the Steam page do not update in real time they will eventually catch up.

If anything does not work please tell me on the forums and I *will* fix it! No more delays!

Again, please accept my sincere apologies for this massive delay.

notes.title: Update log 2022-03-10
notes.notes:
This update includes the following:

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added leaderboard display for the top 100. You can access it via the main menu.
[*] Music now no longer restarts between scenes
[*] Added fallback fonts for various asian languages.
[/list]

The increased download size is due to the addition of the various asian language fonts which are quite large.

notes.title: Hotfix: Score achievements not unlocking
notes.notes:
This update should fix the highscore achievements not unlocking.

They should now also be unlocked retroactively if you already reached the respective score on the Steam leaderboards.

Here's another pre-release update:
[list]
[*]added a pause mode because the game actually didn't have one ... press P or (on Gamepad) Start to pause/unpause
[*]added some rather nice music

notes.title: Day 0 Patch
notes.notes:
Almost ready for prime time now! This update contains:

[list]
[*]switched audio to FMOD because I now use it in all my projects
[*]completely reworked the title screen
[*]added an options menu
[*]slightly increased player movement response time
[*]reworked controller navigation in menus
[*]overhauled the game over screen
[*]rewrote the Steam implementation to upload stats in batches so we're not constantly getting rate limited. This also goes for highscores. If an upload isn't possible the data is cached and uploaded the next time the game is started.
[/list]
